title: NotificationRequestedIntegrationEvent
description: Published by any service that references Notification.Contracts (no production publisher yet); consumed by Notification, which resolves the channel and sends through SendNotificationCommand. Contract source: backend/c#/OmniCore.Services.Notification/OmniCore.Services.Notification.Contracts/Events/NotificationRequestedIntegrationEvent.cs.

Channel.description: "Email" or "Webhook", parsed case-insensitively; an unknown value is logged and dropped.

Recipient.description: An e-mail address, or the configured webhook endpoint name for Webhook.

TemplateKey.description: Fills the {{placeholders}} of the named built-in template.

Model.description: Values for the template placeholders. There is no dedicated secret field: publishers must not put secrets here, because the values end up in the rendered message.

DeduplicationKey.description: Optional; when null the handler uses event:{Id}. Makes a broker redelivery harmless.
